role: java.util.Random bit for bit as inline functions over a 48-bit LCG state: setSeed, next, nextInt, nextInt(n), nextLong, nextDouble, nextFloat, nextBoolean.

structs.name: jrand
structs.java: java.util.Random.seed (a JDK class, not in oracle/src)

gpu: lines 32-36, function jr_int_n: Random.nextInt(n) rejection do-while for a non-power-of-two n, unbounded in principle (expected under two iterations)
notes: java.util.Random is a JDK class, so java is empty. The per-entity and per-role streams in det.h build on this. Arithmetic is unsigned to avoid C signed-overflow UB. State is a single uint64, flat and GPU-friendly.
